versions.changelog:
Initial release of system-architect-agent v1.0.0:

- Provides structured system architecture solutions from unclear business requirements.
- Covers end-to-end workflow: strategy, demand verification, requirements analysis, architecture design, risk assessment, and cost estimation.
- Outputs five key deliverables, including complete proposal documentation and outsourcing specifications.
- Features four supporting sub-skills: requirements analysis, platform architecture design, risk assessment, and cost estimation.
- Implements interactive, multi-step questioning to validate and prioritize business needs.
